The longest river in North America is the **Missouri River**.

* **Missouri River:** ~2,341 miles (3,767 km) long, flowing from western Montana into the Mississippi River north of St. Louis, Missouri.
* **Mississippi–Missouri River System:** Taken together as a single continuous river system, the combined Mississippi–Missouri system is the longest river system in North America (and fourth-longest in the world), measuring about 3,902 miles (6,275 km).
